| Club | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Manchester City | https://crests.football-data.org/65.svg |
| Arsenal | https://crests.football-data.org/57.svg |
| Liverpool | https://crests.football-data.org/64.svg |
| Chelsea | https://crests.football-data.org/61.svg |
| FC Barcelona | https://crests.football-data.org/81.svg |

Club names and crests belong to their respective owners. Included for identification of teams in the synthetic match replay; no club affiliation or endorsement is implied. These assets are not covered by any project source-code license.


## Complete club coverage

`clubs.json` maps all 1,660 club editions, 249 historical name variants and 192 club identities to bundled assets. Each record includes the original source URL and SHA-256 hash. New vectors are from https://github.com/JoseArroyave/football-logos, with historical Arles-Avignon and Évian originals from Wikimedia. Crest choice identifies the club and does not claim a complete season-by-season design timeline.
